id: title:a-lider:rename features to tools in access control settings

review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F5.H3 demonstrates a complete, coherent renaming of the resource type and its associated UI state from 'Feature' to 'Tool'. observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are complete and cover the full change. No missing context, no binary-only or truncated hunks. No unrelated PRs detected; this chunk represents a single, coherent renaming and propagation of a feature-related concept to a tool-related concept.
